justification: Minor: data and test count only, no code. 94 Campbelltown (78) and Hornsby (16) DCP rules limited to the zones the council's headings name; applied live with owner go and a row backup; same step as #1679.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Prints to-change greater than 0 after the apply.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the apply it printed to-change=78 (Campbelltown) and 16 (Hornsby); after, 0 for both.

break_it.scenario: A reader's zone is wrong and a rule is hidden from a zone it applies to.
break_it.what_happens: Houses in that zone lose a rule.
break_it.how: Only rows with a verbatim quote re-found in the council text and real zone codes were used: 149 of 398 zone calls passed. Replay on judged rules: 6 wrong rules hidden, 1 right-judged rule hidden (heading reads Zone R3, house R2).
break_it.repro: Quotes are in the scratch file zone_confirmed2.json.

break_it.scenario: A publish re-sets the narrowed rows.
break_it.how: The step runs after every publish and matches by text fingerprint.
break_it.repro: python scripts/derive_precinct_keys.py --only land_limits --council hornsby prints to-change=0.

break_it.scenario: Hornsby R3/R4 limits hide a rule that also has a height-area limit.
break_it.what_happens: Only R2 houses lose it; R3/R4 houses still see it.
break_it.how: Accepted: the height-area limit is not expressible here.
break_it.repro: Rows are listed in land_limits.json under hornsby.

post_merge.manual_verify: An R2 Campbelltown house no longer shows Zone R3 rules; not checked in a browser.
